properties.name: bootui.mongodb.inspect-enabled
properties.description: Allow explicit MongoDB metadata inspection. Does not schedule any work. Requires restart.

properties.name: bootui.mongodb.authorized-database-enumeration-enabled
properties.description: Allow an explicitly selected AUTHORIZED_NAMES action. Never broadens configured scope. Requires restart.

properties.name: bootui.mongodb.max-clients
properties.description: Maximum locally inventoried MongoDB clients, from 1 through 64. Requires restart.

properties.name: bootui.mongodb.max-databases
properties.description: Maximum retained databases per inspection, from 1 through 32. Requires restart.

properties.name: bootui.mongodb.max-collections-per-database
properties.description: Maximum retained collections per database, from 1 through 200. Requires restart.

properties.name: bootui.mongodb.max-indexes-per-collection
properties.description: Maximum retained indexes per collection, from 1 through 128. Requires restart.

properties.name: bootui.mongodb.max-total-items
properties.description: Whole-inspection retained item budget, from 1 through 5000. Requires restart.

properties.name: bootui.mongodb.max-metadata-bytes
properties.description: Retained metadata byte budget, from 16384 through 2097152. Requires restart.

properties.name: bootui.mongodb.max-text-length
properties.description: Maximum retained text length, from 1 through 1024. Requires restart.

properties.name: bootui.mongodb.timeout-ms
properties.description: Cooperative total inspection budget in milliseconds, from 1 through 30000. Requires restart.

properties.name: bootui.mongodb.operation-timeout-ms
properties.description: Positive operation timeout, no greater than the total budget. A tighter existing client timeout wins. Requires restart.

properties.name: bootui.mongodb.clients
properties.description: Explicit scope keyed by the exact Spring client bean name: clients.<name>.databases is a comma-separated list of exact database names. No URI or authentication-database inference. Requires restart.

properties.name: bootui.startup.enabled
properties.description: Install a BufferingApplicationStartup automatically while BootUI is active so the Startup Timeline panel has data.

properties.name: bootui.startup.capacity
properties.description: Maximum startup steps retained by BootUI's auto-installed startup buffer. Values less than or equal to zero disable the buffer.

properties.name: bootui.force-web
properties.description: While BootUI is active, force a non-web (command-line) application into a servlet web application so the BootUI console can be served. Has no effect on applications that are already servlet web applications or that are explicitly configured as reactive. Set to false to leave the host application's web-application type untouched.

properties.name: bootui.trust-container-gateway
properties.description: Trust the auto-detected container default gateway as a single /32 so BootUI can be reached inside a container with a published port (host->container traffic is SNAT'd to the gateway) without a broad bootui.trusted-proxies CIDR. Defaults to OFF (fail closed); AUTO and ON are explicit opt-ins. OFF never trusts it; AUTO trusts it only when running inside a container; ON trusts a detected gateway even if container heuristics are inconclusive. Relaxes only the source-address check; the Host allow-list and cross-site write protections stay in force.
